New York's showcase: platinum swept the 78th Emmy Awards red carpet, and Tiffany & Co.'s Fifth Avenue design carried the biggest number — Selena Gomez in over 12 carats of platinum-set diamonds.

De Beers London, Cartier, Martin Katz and Lorraine Schwartz all set stones in platinum too, per InStore Magazine and National Jeweler. Platinum Guild International USA's Jenny Luker: "the red carpet is where that individuality comes to life."

New York's tape this morning: gold climbed to $4,329.30 an ounce, up 1.45%, with silver, platinum and palladium all higher too, as the market waits on the Fed.

Gold: $4,329.30/oz, +1.45%. Silver: $64.41/oz, +2.35%. Platinum: $1,775.00/oz, +1.54%. Palladium: $1,292.00/oz, +2.05%. RapNet's one-carat index held flat at 3,904.45.
